fusions.name: Spatter
fusions.desc: Shakes 3 beads of water off your strands, spread apart, each dealing 3 water damage.

fusions.name: Cloudburst
fusions.desc: Sends a heavy wave of water down a strand at the first enemy it meets, dealing 12 water damage and knocking it back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Dripping Eaves
fusions.desc: Lets water run down every strand to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, restoring 14 health to each.

fusions.name: Wet Slate
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 2 mana a second for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
